<div class="card-body">
'''Astromech Shortage''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊操縦ドロイド不足</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">3フォース消費して、場の敵の側に配備する。操縦ドロイド／ナビコン・アイコンのついた宇宙戦闘機はすべて配備コスト＋1となる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Astromech-Shortage-PSA-164793252.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ハイパースペースへの逃亡をふせぐために、宇宙戦闘機の操縦ドロイドを狙い撃ちするのは、帝国軍パイロットの常套手段だ。無傷の操縦ドロイドが不足すれば、宇宙戦闘機の迅速な配備も困難になる。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Astromech shortage.

'''Card text:'''
Use 3 Force to deploy on the opponent's side of the table. All starfighters with an astromech or nav computer icon are deploy +1.

'''Lore:'''
Imperial pilots routinely pick off starfighter astromechs to stop hyperspace escapes. If undamaged astromechs run short, rapid starfighter deployment becomes hard.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese applies deploy +1 to starfighters with those icons; the English names opponent's starships.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Astromech Shortage]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
